K2.text: No second factor for dispatchers; a magic link alone signs in, and no backlog SEC item covers it.

K3.text: Dispatch pages/actions use requireDispatcher, crew requireCrew/currentRole, portal currentPropertyId, photo and complete routes check a session, webhook and cron authenticate by signature/secret; no new unguarded entry points found since Sept.

K6.text: No standing capability URLs: emailed tokens are single-use sign-in links exchanged for a session by POST.

K9.text: Raw-body HMAC with timestamp window; event claim and apply in one transaction so a failure rolls back and Stripe retries.

K10.text: Unconfigured channel throws in production and the console provider logs bodies in development only (SEC-02 fixed); the one console.log is the only log call.

K12.text: Cloud-DB refusal in src/db.ts and prisma.config.ts, e2e on .env.test, Playwright webServer runs build plus next start with E2E_DEV escape hatch.
